title: Historical data compatibility, migration, replay, reconcile, and restore
objective: Prove deterministic zero-to-current replay of the complete V1-V7 historical ledger, versioned compatibility readers, additive corrections, rehearsed migrations with interruption boundaries on WAL-safe live copies, and verified full restoration as one recovery unit - without rewriting history and without touching the live database.
primary_evidence_sources: Live Foundry home database: C:\Users\b\AppData\Local\hermes\foundry\foundry.db (READ-ONLY copies only)
R0 restore bundle: docs/remaster/evidence/r0 (frozen DB backups, git bundle)
Historical event rows: preserved V1-V7 event tables (claims to reconcile, never rewrite)
R4 kernel ledger/projections: src/jarvis_foundry/kernel/** (compatibility readers must map legacy rows to the new ledger without mutation)

mandatory_deliverables.detail: Byte-identical preservation of historical event rows; no rewrite, no backfill, no deletion. Any correction is recorded additively with a correction event.
Readers for each historical schema version that map legacy rows into the R4 kernel's LedgerEvent shape without mutating source tables; unknown/unsupported rows fail closed with explicit reason.
Replay the complete historical ledger from sequence one through the R4 kernel projections; result must be byte-identical across repeated runs and independent of host ordering.
Compare replay output against independently defined invariants (event count, chain integrity, projection state invariants), not just old projection output.
Corrections to historical data are recorded as new events only; no history mutation; a correction ledger documents each correction event with reason and evidence.
Every migration rehearsed on WAL-safe live copies: before/after states, interruption at each step, resume, idempotency, downgrade/rollback boundary, and previous-release readability.
Executable, DB, WAL, config, task, secrets metadata, and evidence restore points kept consistent as one recovery unit; full restoration verified.

mandatory_deliverables.item: No loss or duplication during dual-run/cutover
mandatory_deliverables.detail: Prove no events are lost or duplicated during the rehearsal of dual-run/cutover against copies; idempotency and integrity verified.

mandatory_gates.gate: Complete historical ledger replays deterministically from sequence one with zero unexplained mismatch and byte-identical repeated results
Every historical event row is preserved byte-identical; corrections are additive-only
Every migration runs twice with identical results (idempotent), survives interruption at every boundary, and can roll back to the previous release
Full restoration (executable + DB + WAL + config + task + secrets metadata + evidence) verified on a copy; previous-release readability proven
Zero events lost or duplicated in dual-run/cutover rehearsal; integrity constraints hold
No live/protected state touched; all work on read-only copies; evidence budget under 8 MiB

acceptance_criteria.criterion: R5-D01..D08 each PASS with non-empty evidence (paths, hashes, command outputs).
Replay of the live-copy ledger (or the largest available historical sample) produces identical results on two independent runs and satisfies the independently defined invariants.
Correction events are appended, never applied in place; the correction ledger documents each with reason and evidence.
Migration rehearsal covers interruption at every step with resume and rollback; downgrade boundary proven on a copy.
Restore rehearsed end-to-end on a copy; the restored unit matches the frozen restore-point hashes.
Dual-run/cutover rehearsal shows no loss or duplication and reports a clean reconciliation.
Full repository test suite stays green in the isolated env with the R4 kernel (no regressions); any delta explained exactly.
No live database, task, process, port, or protected file touched; evidence under budget; builder does not commit/push.

ownership.builder: May create scripts/remaster/r5/**, tests/remaster/r5/**, docs/remaster/evidence/r5/**, and additive compatibility source under src/jarvis_foundry/kernel/compat/** (new files only). May read the live-copy DB via mode=ro copies in the isolated temp area. Must NOT edit existing kernel modules, tests/foundry, R1-R4 evidence, FINDINGS.jsonl, work packages, or the live/protected main.
ownership.root: Evidence custody, findings registry, commit decision, final truth.
ownership.verifier: Fresh independent context after builder freeze.

resources_and_constraints.db_copies: C:\Users\b\AppData\Local\Temp\jarvis-r5-* (mode=ro copies; never the live DB)
resources_and_constraints.network_allowed: only pinned dev-tool installs into the isolated venv; no provider calls
resources_and_constraints.timeout: bounded; every long gate prints WALL_SECONDS and EXIT_CODE

status_contract: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED | NOT_TESTED | WAITING only; exit code zero alone is NOT_TESTED; every PASS needs non-empty evidence.
stop_conditions: any mutation of live/protected state or the live database
any rewrite/backfill/delete of historical event rows
any edit to existing kernel modules, tests/foundry, or prior evidence
any commit or push by the builder
any secret value written to evidence
any unrecorded gate failure presented as PASS
builder_status: NOT_TESTED until a fresh independent verifier passes every mandatory criterion
